findings.title: MongoDB server has no password
findings.evidence: ran listDatabases without logging in and got 3 databases: admin, config, local
findings.fix: Turn on access control (security.authorization: enabled in mongod.conf) and create users, or bind MongoDB to localhost only.

findings.title: Redis server has no password
findings.evidence: sent PING without a password and got +PONG
findings.fix: Set requirepass in redis.conf, or bind Redis to localhost only.

findings.title: FTP server allows anonymous login
findings.evidence: logged in as "anonymous", server replied 230 Login successful.
findings.fix: Disable anonymous FTP unless you really mean to share files publicly. For vsftpd set anonymous_enable=NO.

findings.title: SSH server allows password login
findings.evidence: SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_10.2 offers these login methods: publickey, password
findings.fix: Use SSH keys and set PasswordAuthentication no in sshd_config. Passwords can be guessed, keys can't.

findings.title: Unencrypted Telnet server
findings.evidence: (Nmap's name for the Telnet server changes between runs)
findings.fix: Turn off Telnet and use SSH instead. Telnet sends passwords as plain text, so anyone on the network can read them.

findings.title: Server accepts old TLS versions
findings.evidence: server completed a handshake with TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1
findings.fix: Allow only TLS 1.2 and 1.3. In nginx set ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; in Apache set SSLProtocol -all +TLSv1.2 +TLSv1.3.

findings.title: SSH server allows weak algorithms
findings.evidence: SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_10.2 offers weak algorithms: key exchange (diffie-hellman-group14-sha1), cipher (aes128-cbc)
findings.fix: Remove the weak algorithms from KexAlgorithms, HostKeyAlgorithms, Ciphers and MACs in sshd_config, or update OpenSSH. Its defaults are fine.

findings.title: Web server is missing security headers
findings.evidence: GET http://127.0.0.1:18080/ returned 200 without these headers: Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options
findings.fix: Configure the web server to send the missing headers. Most servers can add them in one line of config.

findings.title: Web server is missing security headers
findings.evidence: GET https://127.0.0.1:18443/ returned 200 without these headers: Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security
findings.fix: Configure the web server to send the missing headers. Most servers can add them in one line of config.
